connector.name: Meertrack
connector.registryDescription: Competitive intelligence - track what competitors ship each week. 8 tools, 3 prompt workflows.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.meertrack.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.meertrack, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Either `Bearer mt_live_…` (static API key) or an OAuth 2.1 access token obtained via the authorization server advertised at `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`.

env.name: MEERTRACK_API_KEY
env.description: Meertrack production API key (mt_live_…). Mint at Settings → API Keys.

env.name: MEERTRACK_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional upstream override; defaults to https://api.meertrack.com/v1.
